newsitem.title: UK: Prebon Yamane expands its energy broking Europe.
newsitem.headline: Prebon Yamane expands its energy broking Europe.

text.p: U.S.-based brokerage Prebon Yamane said on Wednesday it has further expanded its energy broking business in Europe.

Prebon Energy has recruited six oil products brokers and a gas broker is the "next logical step in our strategy to grow our energy business," said Steve Miles, Prebon Yamane's managing director for business development.
Last December Prebon bought Oslo based Nordico Energy Products AS. The six man Oslo team joined Prebon's four other offices in New York, Houston, London and Mexico City.
The new oil products brokers hired in London have been a leading heavy fuel oil brokerage team in recent years.
